failure_modes.name: Motor overheat
failure_modes.symptoms: Winding temperature over limit; torque fade; thermal shutdown; stator insulation stress
failure_modes.mitigation: Duty-cycle management; forced convection; thermal-derate control law; IR inspection of windings

failure_modes.name: Head-mast fall damage
failure_modes.component: Head/perception mast (lidar + cameras on upper frame)
failure_modes.symptoms: Mast sheared or loose after tip/impact; sensor misalignment; lost perception; cracked mount
failure_modes.mitigation: Reinforced mast base; crash cage; post-fall calibration check; tip-over reflex to protect upper body

failure_modes.name: Reducer backlash
failure_modes.symptoms: Dead-band on direction reversal; position error under load; audible cogging; degraded tracking
failure_modes.mitigation: Backlash-compensating control; preload maintenance; backlash measurement at service; reducer replacement at wear limit

failure_modes.name: Ankle overload
failure_modes.symptoms: High peak torque on uneven terrain; foot instability; reducer strain; current spikes at heel strike
failure_modes.mitigation: Compliant ankle tuning; terrain-adaptive foot placement; torque limiting; foot-force sensing

failure_modes.name: Power brownout
failure_modes.symptoms: Bus voltage sag under peak demand; compute reset; actuator fault latches; sudden locomotion halt
failure_modes.mitigation: Supercapacitor buffer; bus-undervoltage lockout with graceful shutdown; load-shedding scheduler; cell-balancing
